biggest_catch: CoinOut's own terms say your coins expire if you don't scan a paper receipt for 90 straight days — and its business model is selling your receipt data to companies.
catches: Official terms: rewards expire if you don't submit at least one valid paper receipt in a continuous 90-day period (7-day notice given).
CoinOut was acquired by IRI (2021); its data-platform product packages and sells user receipt/transaction data — that is the revenue model.
Payouts are tiny per receipt; users report low payout rates, account suspensions, and redemption difficulty.
Higher redemption tiers require higher reward levels ($50 requires Diamond).
Coins have no cash value per the terms.

steps: Install the CoinOut app and create a free account.
Scan paper receipts (or connect retailer accounts / use Download Orders for online orders).
Earn coins per receipt; keep scanning at least one paper receipt every 90 days to avoid expiry.
Level up (Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond) for better redemption tiers.
Redeem from $3 (3,000 coins, Silver) for gift cards or cash.
